```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

crops <- read.csv("data/crop_list.csv", header = FALSE)$V1
crops <- sort(trimws(as.character(crops)))
crops <- stringr::str_to_sentence(crops)
cat('<div class="crop-selector">\n')
cat('<label for="crop-input">Select a crop:</label>\n')
cat('<div class="combobox">\n')
cat('<input type="text" id="crop-input" placeholder="Write or click to see all options..." autocomplete="off">\n')
cat('<ul id="crop-dropdown" class="crop-dropdown"></ul>\n')
cat('</div>\n')
cat('</div>\n')

cat('<script id="crop-data" type="application/json">\n')
cat(sprintf('[%s]\n', paste(sprintf('"%s"', crops), collapse = ",")))
cat('</script>\n')
```

::: map-display
<img alt="Selected crop map" id="crop-map" style="display:none;"/>

<p id="crop-placeholder">

</p>

<p id="crop-error" style="display:none; color:#b00;">


</p>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
const allCrops = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('crop-data').textContent);

const input = document.getElementById('crop-input');
const dropdown = document.getElementById('crop-dropdown');
const img = document.getElementById('crop-map');
const placeholder = document.getElementById('crop-placeholder');
const errorMsg = document.getElementById('crop-error');

let highlightedIndex = -1;
let currentOptions = [];

function renderDropdown(options) {
  currentOptions = options;
  highlightedIndex = -1;
  dropdown.innerHTML = '';
  if (options.length === 0) {
    dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  options.forEach((crop, i) => {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.textContent = crop;
    li.dataset.index = i;
    li.addEventListener('click', () => {
      input.value = crop;
      closeDropdown();
      buscarCultivo();
    });
    dropdown.appendChild(li);
  });
  dropdown.style.display = 'block';
}

function openFullList() {
  renderDropdown(allCrops);
}

function filterList(text) {
  const term = text.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (term === '') {
    openFullList();
    return;
  }
  const filtered = allCrops.filter(c => c.toLowerCase().includes(term));
  renderDropdown(filtered);
}

function closeDropdown() {
  dropdown.style.display = 'none';
  highlightedIndex = -1;
}

function updateHighlight() {
  const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li');
  items.forEach((li, i) => {
    li.classList.toggle('highlighted', i === highlightedIndex);
  });
  if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && items[highlightedIndex]) {
    items[highlightedIndex].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }
}

input.addEventListener('click', () => {
  openFullList();
});

input.addEventListener('input', () => {
  filterList(input.value);
});

input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li');
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    highlightedIndex = Math.min(highlightedIndex + 1, items.length - 1);
    updateHighlight();
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    highlightedIndex = Math.max(highlightedIndex - 1, 0);
    updateHighlight();
  } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && currentOptions[highlightedIndex]) {
      input.value = currentOptions[highlightedIndex];
      closeDropdown();
    }
    buscarCultivo();
  } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    closeDropdown();
  }
});

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.combobox')) {
    closeDropdown();
  }
});


function buscarCultivo() {
  const crop = input.value.trim();
  closeDropdown();

  if (allCrops.includes(crop)) {
    placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    errorMsg.style.display = 'none';
    img.style.display = 'block';
    img.src = `images/${crop}.png`;
    img.alt = `Crop map: ${crop}`;
  } else {
    img.style.display = 'none';
    placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    errorMsg.style.display = 'block';
  }
}
</script>
```
